surface: gh plate context, plate_contexts/plate_context MCP tools, docs/wiki/Agent-Context-Map.md
summary: Adds a canonical PLATE context map so agents can retrieve discovery guidance from one shared model instead of inferring the right artifact from several prompt surfaces.
migration_impact: Downstream PLATE surfaces can point to gh plate context list/show and the context-map wiki page as the default discovery front door. This reduces duplicated routing guidance in prompt files and makes source-of-truth lookup more direct.
agent_notes: When the task is to figure out where authoritative truth lives, start with the context map rather than scanning AGENTS.md, prompt entrypoints, and deep docs in parallel.
migration_guidance: 1. Update thin prompt surfaces to point to gh plate context list/show or the matching MCP tools instead of carrying their own routing tables.
2. Keep docs/wiki/Agent-Context-Map.md aligned with the runtime context-map model.
3. Use the concern ids from the context map in future delegation and discovery features.
